title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. In this coordinate system, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of the first loop, which includes four lines. Start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0192, 0.0). Then, draw the second line from (0.0192, 0.0) to (0.0192, 0.75). Next, draw the third line from (0.0192, 0.75) to (0.0, 0.75). Finally, draw the fourth line from (0.0, 0.75) back to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0192 units in the direction of the normal to create a new solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction of the normal. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism are 0.01923076923076923 meters in length, 0.7499999999999998 meters in width, and 0.01923076923076923 meters in height. This rectangular prism serves as the base for a cylindrical object with slightly rounded top and bottom, positioned horizontally.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0192, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0192, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.0192)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0192, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0192, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.75) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0192)

# Apply the translation
